mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket ( title, description, category, impact_scope, urgency, status, priority, priority_reason, creator_id, handler_id, deadline_time ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{impactScope}, #{urgency}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{priorityReason}, #{creatorId}, #{handlerId}, #{deadlineTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, category, impact_scope, urgency, status, priority, priority_reason, creator_id, handler_id, overdue, escalation_level, create_time, update_time, close_time, deadline_time FROM ticket WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, title, description, category, impact_scope, urgency, status, priority, priority_reason, creator_id, handler_id, overdue, escalation_level, create_time, update_time, close_time, deadline_time FROM ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') AND deadline_time < #{now} AND overdue = 0 ORDER BY deadline_time ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW(), close_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CLOSED' THEN NOW() ELSE close_time END WHERE id = #{ticketId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND (handler_id = #{handlerId} OR #{handlerId} IS NULL)
UPDATE ticket SET overdue = 1, escalation_level = escalation_level + 1, status = 'OVERDUE', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{ticketId}
